claims.statement: Announcement-format categories are described as supporting maintainer updates, releases, and events, with new discussions restricted to maintain or admin permissions while comments and replies are broadly described as available. The word anyone does not establish anonymous access or bypass repository visibility, authentication, or moderation restrictions.

Every discussion is described as category-bound; repository maintain or admin permissions define repository categories, and maintain or admin permissions on an organization source repository define organization categories. The listed formats are open-ended, question-and-answer, and announcement; this is product behavior, not accepted project policy or an observed permission test.

Discussions are characterized as a community conversation forum for a repository or organization. Open forum is descriptive, not proof that private resources are publicly accessible, that moderation is absent, or that this estate has enabled the feature.

Organization discussions use an existing or dedicated source repository and are shown on both organization and source-repository discussion pages. Participation and management follow source-repository permissions, with write access given as the deletion example; no actual entitlement or deletion capability was verified.

The source repository can be changed, but existing discussions are explicitly not transferred to the replacement. This distinction is a migration and custody caveat, not authorization to change configuration or evidence of a completed transfer.

Adding a category to a section is optional and a category is limited to one section at a time. The local creation anchor requires its containing page; the screenshot caption describes the UI but the image was not inspected and supplies no live configuration or enforcement evidence.

The fragment instructs opening a chosen discussion from its list. It is a navigation step only, not evidence that the discussion exists, that the reader can access it, or that any configuration or moderation action was performed.
